title: Virtual Visit
summary: Motion identity for the Yale School of Art 2027 MFA Admission Virtual Visit.
credits:
Design: Junyeol Baek
Client: Yale School of Art
description:
Announcements for the school's online open day, one for each channel — event page, Instagram post and story — and one for each programme: Graphic Design, Painting/Printmaking, Photography and Sculpture. A cursor moves across the title and lights up its letters one by one; the date drops in as a calendar tab.

December 10, 2026, 12pm EST, online via Zoom.
